description: Standard happy path: no cooldown, consent recorded for email, no duplicate/conflicting activity, opportunity mid-lifecycle. All EIGHT deterministic gates pass and the run recommends a single, appropriately-scoped next action. CONVERTED TO v2 (P1.10d-7). The v1 fixture asserted a NINTH gate, `fos.next_best_action.no-prohibited-guarantee`, which this definition NO LONGER DECLARES — the keyword gate was replaced by the stage-7b semantic classifier in #109/#110, so asserting it is now a distinct grader failure (design section 5 rule 4). Stage-7b coverage is asserted via `compliance_review_blocked: false` instead. v1's `output_schema_constraints` were prose; the mechanizable subset is now `output_assertions`, and the rest stays here, asserted by nothing: that summary and rationale carry no employment/salary/interview guarantee is a judgment there is deliberately no operator for (a keyword operator is the exact brittleness that leaked four times as lesson P-004, and #110 replaced it with a semantic classifier), and it is asserted by `compliance_review_blocked` plus the agent's own FOS1-NBA-10 unit test. v1 also asserted `isContact true`, a field the output schema does not and must not have — contact-ness is DERIVED from the closed `actionType` enum precisely so a model cannot set it.
